description: Tracks point balances across all user cards globally and provides optimal redemption strategies — including direct redemption, transfer partner valuations, multi-hop transfer chains, point purchase opportunities, and milestone-aware recommendations.

strategies.redemption_option: Transfer to Hyatt for 2 nights at a Category 5 hotel
strategies.details: Transfer 40,000 UR to World of Hyatt for 2 nights at a Category 5 property valued at $425/night. This yields 2.1 cents per point, far exceeding the 1.5cpp travel portal rate.
strategies.transfer_chain_steps: Chase UR -> World of Hyatt (1:1 transfer, instant)
strategies.warnings: Hyatt award availability can be limited during peak seasons. Book early.

point_purchase_opportunities.current_promotion: Buy points at 0.5 cents/point (regular 1 cent/point) — 50% bonus sale
point_purchase_opportunities.recommended_use_case: Top up if you're within 10,000 points of a free night at a premium property
point_purchase_opportunities.is_worth_it: Yes, if redeeming for 0.6+ cents/point value

transfer_limits_summary.limit_description: Maximum 30,000 points per partner transfer per transaction
transfer_limits_summary.workaround: Split into multiple transfer requests of 30,000 points each

example_response.summary: Your portfolio's highest-value move is transferring Chase UR to Hyatt for 2.1 cpp. Consider the Hilton points sale to top up for a free night.
